desiredBehavior: An operator opens case C-204 from the queue, checks evidence in a distinct review domain, returns to the queue with the same case and draft filter, then revisits review without implying approval.
primaryGoal: Review the same case without losing context or committing a decision

domains.riskModel: Do not mistake a queue selection for approval

domains.primaryGoal: Assess one case and its evidence
domains.interactionModel: Inspect evidence and prepare a decision
domains.riskModel: Do not commit without a human decision

mobileDirection.reorder: Put decision summary before secondary evidence on narrow screens
mobileDirection.collapse: Collapse long evidence list behind a summary
mobileDirection.replace: Replace side-by-side queue and case context with focused case navigation
mobileDirection.status: authored responsive v1 plan exercised with synthetic browser evidence; semantic parity and user outcomes require review
